## Description

Proposed hierarchical approach to trade-execution optimization: Plan order timing and slicing over an execution horizon to balance expected slippage, market impact, completion risk, and liquidity. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
